mapper.select: select id, latitude lat, longitude lon from `vm_aiot_energy_station_info_t` where `del_flag` = 0 and longitude is not null and longitude is not null order by id

select m.device_code as code, m.device_name as name, m.online_status status, m.province_id, m.city_id, m.county_id, m.town_code, pro.area_name as provinceName, city.area_name as cityName, county.area_name as countyName, '1' as prolevel, '2' as citylevel, '3' as countrylevel, '4' as deviceLevel from vm_order_energy_devices o left join vm_aiot_energy_device_info_t m on m.device_code = o.device_code and o.category_code = m.device_type left join sys_area pro on pro.area_code = m.province_id left join sys_area city on city.area_code = m.city_id left join sys_area county on county.area_code = m.county_id where o.delete_flag= '0' and m.del_flag= '0' and o.tenant_id =#{param.tenantId} and o.industry_code = #{param.industryCode} and o.ord_status in (0,1,2) order by m.province_id, m.city_id, m.county_id, m.device_code

update.foreach: update vm_aiot_energy_station_info_t set province_id = #{item.provinceId}, province_name = #{item.provinceName}, city_id = #{item.cityId}, city_name = #{item.cityName}, county_id = #{item.countyId}, county_name = #{item.countyName}, location = #{item.address} where id = #{item.id}

mapper.update: update sys_tenant_cascade_device_rel rel, sys_plat_cascade_device_config c set rel.`custom_channel_code` = c.`custom_channel_code` where rel.plat_code = c.plat_code and rel.device_code = c.device_code and rel.channel_code = c.channel_code and (rel.`custom_channel_code` is null or rel.`custom_channel_code` = '')
update sys_tenant_cascade_device_rel rel, vm_device_info_t t set rel.org_code = t.county_id where rel.device_code = t.device_code and (rel.org_code is null or rel.org_code = '')
mapper.select: select rel.tenant_id, rel.plat_code, rel.device_code, t.province_id, pro.area_name provinceName, t.city_id, city.area_name cityName, t.county_id, county.area_name countyName from sys_tenant_cascade_device_rel rel inner join vm_device_info_t t on rel.device_code = t.device_code LEFT JOIN sys_area pro on pro.area_code = t.province_id LEFT JOIN sys_area city on city.area_code = t.city_id LEFT JOIN sys_area county on county.area_code = t.county_id
